base_contract: PR6736 design sections 2/3/10 T4; merged T2 (domain phases) and T3 (stimulus parent phases, PR6743)

behavior.inputs: hosted_all12_chain (default false), chain_id, chain_phase (A_research..E_close), chain_input_json (nonsecret decisions/predecessors only), chain_prior_receipt_run_id (artifact lookup hint)
behavior.mode_separation: deploy-dev and isolated job conditions gain !hosted_all12_chain; hosted job rejects isolated_provider_qualification=true at validation; default release and isolated qualification are otherwise unchanged; no needs/deploy/compensation/FE switch in the hosted job
behavior.guards: exact current dev (GITHUB_REF/GITHUB_SHA/payload == origin/dev), component=auto, allow_dirty=false, strict auth, existing concurrency group with cancel-in-progress false, chain id pattern equal to the parent's, credential/approval keys rejected in chain_input_json
behavior.identity: accepted hosted FE/BFF pair read from FE /deployment.json + BFF /bff/version (must agree, accepted state with releaseAdmission); recorded in accepted-identity.json separately from workflow_source_sha; that backend sha is PANTHEON_L12_STIMULUS_EXPECTED_SHA and the VM managed checkout must be that exact clean HEAD
behavior.lease: existing dev_environment_lease.py (pinned controller aee1243, checksum-verified) acquire --mode qualification + identity-bound heartbeat for A/B/C/E; D_observe takes no lease; the release step runs always, so pause and failure release; it never holds across a human wait; a lost heartbeat or unprovable identity quarantines to TTL and fails the job
behavior.execution: one ssh stdin transfer of the CI pip wheel + the five pytest closure wheels pinned from dependencies/locks/root-tests.txt and a workflow-staged runner; VM creates a private scratch venv --without-pip, bootstraps the transferred pip wheel via sys.path+runpy, installs offline --no-index; invokes only tests/integration/l12/test_stimulus_cross_loop_deployed_e2e.py::test_hosted_chain_phase from the accepted managed checkout; no host/global/container install, restart, image, daemon or service
behavior.owner_endpoints: published host ports are read from the running compose containers (docker port), compose files from the BFF container label; no default ports are assumed
behavior.credentials: runner does the existing dev-login exchange immediately before use; token plus actor/roles/tenant travel only on ssh stdin; service credentials are read privately from the running consumers' own config; nothing in dispatch inputs, argv, receipt or upload; phase.log is redacted of every gathered secret value
behavior.receipt: receipt.json (the parent's atomic Evidence file incl. hosted block), segment-result.json, segment-meta.json, accepted-identity.json, redacted phase.log are uploaded always (success, pause, failure); a paused segment exits 0 and is reported complete=false; all12_claim_allowed is true only for E_close completed with the parent's all12_passed true

validation.workflow_guard_tests: scripts/test_isolated_l12_provider_workflow.py (19 passed): mode exclusivity, lease mode/ordering, credential containment, validation script via temp git (stale sha, isolated+hosted, bad chain id, bad phase, credential/approval keys), VM runner with fake docker/git/pytest (env assembly, redaction, dirty/other checkout refused, parent never launched), phase list and env names vs the merged parent
validation.combined_join: tests/unit/l12 (71 passed) incl. test_hosted_stimulus_contract.py real-shaped paused and completed receipts accepted by the parent; no hosted run, no provider call
validation.bootstrap: the extracted runner's bootstrap was executed locally against real wheels: --without-pip venv, pip wheel via runpy, --no-index install, pytest 9.1.1 importable, pip absent from venv
validation.existing_contract_tests: scripts/test_dev_direct_ssh_workflow_contract.py and the lease/artifact/ppl/loop-prod contract files: failure set equals the pre-existing base failures (7 in test_dev_environment_lease_deploy_contract.py plus ppl gate cases fail identically without this change)
